commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' Cslib/Languages/CCS/BehaviouralTheory.lean && sed -n '1,210p' Cslib/Languages/CCS/Semantics.lean && rg -n 'theorem (follow_fst|follow_snd)|def IsBisimulation|def Bisimilarity|theorem .*bisimilarity|theorem refl' Cslib/TransitionSystem"

/bin/bash -lc 'for v in v4.32.0 v4.31.0; do echo "$v"; sed -n '"'282,395p' /localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/cslib-"'$v/Cslib/Languages/CCS/BehaviouralTheory.lean; rg -n '"'theorem Bisimilarity.follow_(fst|snd)|theorem HomBisimilarity.refl' /localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/cslib-"'$v/Cslib/Foundations/Semantics/LTS/Bisimulation.lean; done'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice hb =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨q', hq, h'⟩ := hb.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL hq, .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨p', hp, h'⟩ := hb.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL hp, .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim hb =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨q', hq, h'⟩ := hb.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨q', hq, .bisim h'⟩
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨p', hp, h'⟩ := hb.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨p', hp, .bisim h'⟩
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

method_note: Shell commands and visible correctness outcomes only; no reasoning text. rg/sed is a literal command-presence indicator, not a semantic retrieval score.
